evidence.summary: Prebook usePaymentSdk:true -> payment component (publicKey sandbox, Stripe test card) redirect_status succeeded -> book TRANSACTION_ID CONFIRMED at the prebook price with commission. Provider behaviour: "payment not completed" (2014) uses up the clientReference (repeat 4005, lookup none); the transaction is single-use (another reference answers 2014); a repeat of the booking reference is 4005 and the lookup finds the booking. Refundable cancel: penalty 0.

Staff order commands from /yonetim on an SDK-paid booking: check status (GET /bookings/{id}) CONFIRMED, unchanged; cancel (PUT /bookings/{id}) CANCELLED, cancellation_fee 0, refund_amount 173.36 EUR = the full amount the customer paid. Whether and when that refund reaches the customer's card is not observable in sandbox and not documented (provider question 10a): the order goes to REFUND_PENDING with a refund confirmation task.

Sandbox chain passed: search -> prebook (no change flags) -> book with ACC_CREDIT_CARD (sandbox test card) CONFIRMED -> lookup by clientReference CONFIRMED -> cancel CANCELLED, penalty 0, full refund. Searched with margin 1%. Production card attachment still unverified.

Search results requested with margin 0 (net rates) were refused at prebook with HTTP 409 / code 2001 in 7 attempts; margins 0.5%, 1%, 5%, 10%, 12.5% and the account default prebooked fine. Resolved by business decision ADR-0006: own-gateway hotels use the provider API margin from the approved pricing policy (net + local margin stays available if Nuitee enables margin 0).

ADR-0006 chain with margin 10%: prebook price 1521.09 EUR with commission 138.27 EUR (net 1382.82); pricing core accepted the commission as the requested margin; book with ACC_CREDIT_CARD CONFIRMED, supplier cost 1521.09 EUR (commission included), booking reports commission 138.27 EUR; lookup CONFIRMED; cancel CANCELLED, penalty 0, refund 1521.09 EUR. Commission payout timing (weekly, after checkout) is documentation-only.
